Subject: RE: Cargo inquiry - 20,000 MT fertilizer Constanta / Alexandria
To: management@etm-services.net

Dear colleagues,

Thank you for reverting. Following further confirmation from our shippers, the cargo volume has been revised upwards. We are now looking at 22,000 to 25,000 mts of fertilizer in bulk. Kateryna Boyko

subject: RE: 30,000 MT cement Suez / Nacala - counter freight
body:
---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Osama <osama@badrgroup.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Apr 2026 15:55:00 +0200
Subject: RE: 30,000 MT cement Suez / Nacala - counter freight
To: management@etm-services.net

Dear Sirs,

Thank you for your offer of USD 37.50/mt. After careful consideration, your rate is too high for our principals at this stage.

Our maximum acceptable freight is USD 34.00/mt FIO basis.

For reference, our full counter terms:
Cargo: 30,000 mts cement in pp bags (50kg)
Load: Ain Sokhna, Egypt - 1 sb aaaa
Disch: Nacala, Mozambique - 1 sb aaaa
Laycan: 01-10 Oct 2026
Loading: 5,000 mts SHINC
Disch: 3,000 mts SHINC
FRT counter: USD 34.00/mt FIO
Demurrage: USD 9,000 PDPR / FD BENDS
Commission: 3.75% TTL

Kindly revert with owners best.

brgds
Osama
Badr Group International
snippet: Counter freight USD 34.00/mt FIO vs your USD 37.50 - 30,000 MT cement Suez / Nacala...
